mi.title: XXMI Launcher
mi.directoryHint: Stored in data beside QAQR by default. Updates preserve Mods and existing settings.
mi.completed: Components installed and verified; paths updated
mi.componentMissing: The embedded XXMI installer is missing. Rebuild or reinstall QAQR.
mi.invalidComponent: The embedded XXMI installer failed verification
mi.unsupported: This game or component does not support XXMI installation
mi.timeout: The installer timed out. Check the connection and try again.
mi.busy: Another XXMI operation is in progress. Try again later.
mi.closeForUpdate: Close the game and XXMI Launcher before updating official components.
mi.saveFailed: Components were installed, but QAQR could not save the paths. Select them again.
mi.recoveryRequired: Automatic rollback is incomplete. Recovery files are preserved at {{path}}. Close the locking program and restore the files before updating again.
mi.legacyMigrationDeferred: Migration could not finish. The original directory remains in use; restart after resolving the issue to retry. {{error}}

fork.title: {{importer}} components
fork.scope: Switch each component on its own. Only the files listed below are replaced; the Launcher, Mods and settings stay as they are. Restart the game to apply; F10 does not replace a loaded DLL.

runtime.updateHint: Updating official files keeps the active fix. Switching to official uses the updated files.
runtime.description: Replaces d3d11.dll · the fix adds incremental saving and activity detection
runtime.inactiveOnDx12: The game is in DX12 mode and does not load d3d11.dll, so this choice applies once it is back on DX11

core.officialUpdateHint: Update the official Core and ShaderFixes while preserving Mods and settings.
core.updateHint: Updating Core applies the official version; you can select the fix again afterwards. Mods and settings are preserved.
core.description: Replaces the MergedSkeleton INI, HLSL and shader cache · the fix supports structured skeleton buffers

fork.switched: {{name}} switched to {{target}}. Restart the game to apply.
fork.approvalHint: The fixed DLL needs Unsafe Mode: select this game in the Launcher, turn it on in Advanced Settings, and save. This permits custom DLLs for this MI and skips the upstream DLL signature check.
fork.confirmDescription: The installed {{name}} files are neither official nor the QAQR fix. They cannot be recovered after switching to {{target}}.
fork.confirmRequired: These files cannot be recovered after replacing them. Confirm first.
fork.unsupported: This game has no QAQR fix.
fork.notInitialized: First install and configure this game’s MI in the Launcher.
fork.bundleMissing: The QAQR fix component is missing. Update or rebuild QAQR.
fork.invalidBundle: The QAQR fix component failed verification.
fork.approvalRequired: Turn on and save Unsafe Mode for this game in the Launcher first.
fork.officialMissing: The Launcher has no official DLL. Update once in the Launcher first.
fork.runtimeNotAdapted: The fix does not cover official {{version}} yet.
fork.unknownRuntime: The installed DLL has an unknown origin. Switch to official before enabling the fix.
fork.unknownCore: The installed files are not a known version. Switch to official before enabling the fix.
fork.coreMismatch: The fix targets EFMI {{fork}}, but {{version}} is installed. Switching is unavailable.
fork.writeFailed: Replacing the files failed and they were rolled back. Close the game and try again.
fork.vulkanActive: The Vulkan runtime is in use. Switch it under Vulkan Mod

language.unsupported: This language is not available yet

gameVisibility.title: Game visibility
gameVisibility.description: Turn off a game to hide it from the sidebar, Mod state, download filters, and other game lists. Settings, downloads, and Mods are retained. Turn it on to restore visibility.
gameVisibility.keepVisible: Keep at least one game visible

game.officialLauncherHint: Official launch opens this program without loading Mods. Select launcher.exe or NTELauncher.exe if automatic detection is incorrect.

range.saveHint: Press Enter or leave the field to save

efmiVulkan.description: Installs a d3d11.dll with the Vulkan backend and removes the -force-d3d11 launch argument. Turning it off restores the matching DX11 build
efmiVulkan.runtimeDescription: Original comes from upstream release {{official}} · The fixed build adds the QAQR fixes to it
efmiVulkan.forkMissing: This version does not include the fixed build
efmiVulkan.limits: Experimental: not every Mod works yet. Only a few DX11 ShaderRegex material patches convert automatically, and RabbitFX needs its Vulkan build. Restart the game to apply
efmiVulkan.confirmDescription: The local d3d11.dll is neither the official build nor the QAQR fixed build, and cannot be recovered after Vulkan is turned on
efmiVulkan.enabled: Vulkan is on. Restart the game to apply
efmiVulkan.disabled: Back on DX11. Restart the game to apply
efmiVulkan.switched: Switched to {{target}}. Restart the game to apply
